articleBodyHtml:
Candy Preferences

The speaker has a strong preference for certain types of candy. They love a specific candy and have even ordered it, indicating a clear fondness for it. Additionally, they enjoy sour gummy worms, particularly the mixed berry bags, which they describe as their favorite among gummy candies.

Despite their love for sour gummy worms and other candies, the speaker dislikes lemonade. This shows that while they enjoy certain types of candy, they are not fond of lemon-flavored drinks.

The speaker also mentions candy corn, noting that when stacked, it resembles actual corn, which is why it's called candy corn. This highlights their familiarity with the candy and its visual resemblance to real corn.

relatedStreams.title: 1回でSSR3人、それでも持ち帰れない　NerissaがStarSaviorで「ガチャを回す喜び」を満喫

relatedStreams.title: Nerissa Ravencroft、『AGREE』の「同意」地獄に挑戦　2時間で10/12まで進む
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: Nerissa Ravencroftが、FUWAMOCOとBibooに勧められたゲーム『AGREE』に挑戦した。配信後にダンスレッスンを控え、使える時間は約2時間。ゲームを始めるための「同意」は一度押せば終わりではなく、パズルや計算、料理、認証コード入力などへ次々と姿を変えてNerissaを足止めする。最後まで「Doki Doki Action Game」にたどり着けないまま、それでも12段階中10まで進めて配信を終えた。

relatedStreams.title: NerissaとInaがAmiAmiでクリスマスギフト探し　店内を巡って見つけた「相手らしい一品」

They mention that they have never had the chance to play Honkai Impact before because they already play one Mihoyo game, which makes it difficult to play another.
